scope: Authored static component cases; no generated binding execution or end-to-end migration.
inventory_method: Expected affected sites and candidate/binding outcomes authored by inspection before running production analysis. Affected sites may be conditional or supplied by a caller contract; static proof is separately inventoried. This is not an independent human baseline.
old_schema: syntax="proto3"; package fleet; message Vehicle { float speed_mps=1; }
new_schema: syntax="proto3"; package fleet; message Vehicle { float ground_speed_mps=1; }
intended_behavior: Rename speed_mps to ground_speed_mps, preserve meters/second and strict >30.0 speeding threshold.

binding_policy.assumption: Explicit standard generated-module identity declared for these authored examples; not runtime import resolution.

typescript.assumption: Explicit standard ts-proto emitted module identity; const flow only, no runtime import resolution or monkeypatching.
